title: directjump
author: Robbie
description: Direct Jump and Start on Bar for the Digitone mk1. SETTINGS > DIRECT JUMP, ticked: a pattern picked while the sequencer plays takes over on the next step, legato, from the same place in the bar (per-track scale mode included). SETTINGS > START ON BAR, ticked: a pick starts its pattern from the first step on the next bar line of the Digitone's song position, so it never loses a beat: pressing the playing pattern's key relaunches it, and with DIRECT JUMP unticked other patterns start so too. DIGISNAKE 1.1 relaunches its paths with a start. Unticked, the stock behaviour. Chains play on as stock and song mode is left alone. Saved with the project; on OS 1.44 the settings survive a power cycle. For OS 1.44; needs core-dn1 3.3 or later (4.1.1 recommended with several SETTINGS rows).
